div.head: Ine 49.3
div.ab: Gif mon nime æbesne on swinum: æt þry fingrum ðæt ðridde, æt twy fingrum ðæt feorþe, æt ðymelum ðæt fifte.
Gif mon nime æfesne on swynum: æt þryfingrum þæt ðridde, æt twyfingrum þæt feorðe, æt þymelum þæt fifte.
Si pasnagium capiatur de porcis: de tridigitali tertius, de duodigitali quartus, de þimelo quintus.
Gif mon nime æfesne on swynum: æt þryfingrum þæt ðridde, æt twyfingrum þæt feorðe, æt þymelum þæt fifte.
If [rent] for pasturage is paid in pigs: [if the bacon is] three-fingers thick, [let it be] every third [pig], at two-fingers, every fourth, at [the width of] a thumb, every fifth.
If pannage is paid in pigs', every third pig shall be taken when the bacon is three fingers thick, every fourth when the bacon is two fingers thick, and every fifth when it is a thumb thick.
If one takes pannage in pigs, [one is to take] the third with the bacon three fingers thick, the fourth with it two fingers thick, the fifth with it a thumb thick.

Wenn man [als Grundherr vom Viehbesitzer Mast-]Abgabe an Schweinen nimmt, [so erhalte man als Zins] bei 3 Finger dickem (Speck) [der Schweine je] das dritte, bei 2 Finger dickem das vierte, bei daumendickem das fünfte.

If [as landlord] one takes [pannage-]dues in pigs [from the owner of the livestock], [let one receive as rent] for (bacon) three fingers thick [each] third [pig], for two fingers thick the fourth, for a thumb thick the fifth.
